_about: Names for Frogger's routines and globals, with the evidence for each.
This file exists because `recovered/frogger.asm` is gitignored and must
stay so -- a byte-identical reconstruction is the game. What can be kept
is the *reading*: addresses, names, and why. Run tools/annotate.py to
apply these to a freshly generated listing and get source that still
reassembles to the original, byte for byte.
Routine keys are file offsets, which is the coordinate comrec's labels
use. Global keys are the addresses the program sees -- add 0x100.
Getting those two the wrong way round is the mistake that costs a
session, and the only symptom is silence: a key in the wrong coordinate
substitutes nowhere and nothing complains. annotate.py now reports it.
`why` is not decoration. A name with no evidence behind it is a guess
that will be believed by the next reader.
